definitions.explanation: Used in written/formal contexts; describes killing on a large scale

examples.japanese: ⟦{無差別|むさべつ}→無差別：13492_musabetsu⟧な{殺戮|さつりく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An indiscriminate massacre was carried out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{殺戮|さつりく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}して→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We must not repeat the slaughter caused by war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧{殺戮|さつりく}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The history textbook describes in detail the mass slaughter that occurred in this region.

notes:
A strong, literary word for large-scale killing. It carries connotations of brutality and indiscriminate violence. Commonly encountered in historical writing, news about conflicts, and fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧{殺戮|さつりく}: mass slaughter
- ⟦{無差別|むさべつ}→無差別：13492_musabetsu⟧{殺戮|さつりく}: indiscriminate massacre
- {殺戮|さつりく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out a massacre
- {殺戮|さつりく}⟦{兵器|へいき}→兵器：11679_heiki⟧: weapon of mass destruction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{虐殺|ぎゃくさつ}→虐殺：14333_gyakusatsu⟧: massacre, genocide (emphasizes cruelty and oppression; often used for political killings)
- ⟦{殺害|さつがい}→殺害：13226_satsugai⟧: killing, murder (neutral term for causing death; can refer to a single victim)
- {惨殺|ざんさつ}: brutal murder (emphasizes the gruesome manner of killing)

WRITING:
The second character {戮|りく} is rare outside this word and is sometimes written in hiragana as {殺|さつ}りく in newspapers, following the practice of simplifying rarely-used kanji.
